clean_description: Hillbilly Elegy is a memoir by J.D. Vance that explores his upbringing in a working-class family from the Rust Belt. It examines the struggles of white working-class Americans, particularly focusing on themes of poverty, addiction, and family trauma. Vance reflects on his family's journey from Kentucky to Ohio and his own path to success, highlighting the challenges faced by those trying to achieve upward mobility in America.
setting: Rust Belt America, primarily Ohio and Kentucky
